stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 4.

This is why we love the movies: it’s like going on a roller coaster for the brain.

Why does the author use this comparison?

options.label: A
options.text: To illustrate the level of excitement a movie can provide

options.label: B
options.text: To explain the filmmaking techniques used by movie directors

options.label: C
options.text: To show how movies help people cope with real-world worries

options.label: D
options.text: To describe the mental processes involved with making a movie

visual_elements: This is why we love the movies: it’s like going on a roller coaster for the brain.
